Hi,

I just solved the issue, Ithad to do with the version of R and RTools that I was working with. Originally I tried with the 4.2 version. However, after checking the tutorials and the warnings messages from RStudio, I understood it! I installed the 4.4 version, and now it is working smoothly!

Thank you so much for your help!

Kind regards,
Oscar
